items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: T. Gordon and I playing out in the snow together... Ziggy got his horn and Jack got his horn and got mine. There was four damn fools out there playing in the snow.

ctx.x: Who was Jack with? Was he with his own band when you first met him? Or was he with the...

Jack T. Gordon? Yeah, when you first met him. No, I don't remember when I first met him, but I remember him when he was playing with Glenn Gray's Castle. I was up in Indianapolis. Ziggy Ellman and that group. And they would come over to where I was playing at the sunset. They were playing at the theater at Alta. And that's why I told you about T. Gordon and I playing out in the snow together. I don't think you ever told me. I didn't. Well, they came down there and they came into the sunset and we rushed up there…
When you were on the road like that, did you ever meet Benny Goodman or Tommy Dorsey or Don Stratton?
